newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-GRASSHOPPER BEAT AJAX TO MAINTAIN 100 PERCENT RECORD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GRASSHOPPER BEAT AJAX TO MAINTAIN 100 PERCENT RECORD.

text.p: Unfancied Grasshopper Zurich beat former holders Ajax Amsterdam 1-0 in the European Cup Champions' League on Wednesday and will fancy their chances of a first appearance in the last eight of Europe's premier club competition.

Belying a slow start to their domestic league season, the Swiss champions maintained their 100 percent record in Group A courtesy of a thundering long-distance free-kick by Murat Yakin midway through the second half.

The Swiss, who beat Glasgow Rangers 3-0 in their opening Champions' League match, gained sweet revenge for the 3-0 defeat they suffered in Amsterdam at the same stage of last season's competition. This was the first time Ajax had lost to a Swiss side in European competition.

Ajax, who have scored only five goals in seven games in the Dutch first division this season, were left to rue several spurned chances and a fine display from Grasshopper goalkeeper Pascal Zuberbuehler.
